title: Interpretable four-class machine learning prediction of initial I-131 therapy responses in differentiated thyroid cancer.
snippet: Differentiated thyroid carcinoma (DTC) responses to initial post-operative I-131 therapy are heterogeneous. Standard binary models combine incomplete responses into a 'non-excellent' category, obscuring transitional states (indeterminate response [IDR] and biochemical incomplete response [BIR]) and outcome-specific drivers. title: Pretherapeutic radiological sarcopenia in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma: a narrative review.
snippet: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains one of the deadliest solid malignancies despite advances in surgery, perioperative care, and systemic therapies. Pretherapeutic radiological sarcopenia has emerged as a clinically relevant body-composition phenotype associated with poor outcomes in oncology.
